title: Interviewers Async Mentoring Curriculum — 8-week pilot
content:
Purpose:
Run a lightweight, asynchronous mentoring program for interviewers to raise question design, evaluation consistency, and evidence capture across hiring panels. Target: reduce mismatch between rubric scores and hiring outcomes by 20% in Q1 pilot teams.

Scope:
- Interviewers across Eng (infra, serving-runtime, product) + People Ops hiring panels.
- 8-week curriculum, 1–2 async micro-modules per week, followed by 1 optional live calibration sync at week 4 and week 8.
- Emphasize: short artifacts, example-led learning, mini-tasks (review 3 de-identified candidate writeups).

High-level schedule (week -> deliverable / activity):
1: Welcome + baseline quiz (5m). Watch short vids: bias refresher, evidence-first note-taking (links).
2: Rubric anatomy — primary/secondary signals. Microtask: annotate 2 candidate responses.
3: Behavioral probes — consistency matrix. Template: 3 Qs + scoring notes.
4: Optional live: 30m calibration show-and-tell. Homework: submit one imbalance case.
5: Role-specific signal deep dive (eng infra vs product). Ask mentors for role examples.
6: Speed debriefs — practice 10m async score reconciliations.
7: Hiring decision synthesis — how to write an evidence-led recommendation (template included).
8: Wrap + pulse survey + commitment card (sign up to mentor next cohort).

Core artifacts to produce for pilot:
- Interviewer micro-quiz bank (short answer + multiple choice)
- De-identified candidate vignettes (15 total) with model annotations
- 1-page quick rubric cheatsheet per role family
- Asynchronous review checklist (what to paste into panel notes)

Minimum facilitator actions (People Ops):
- Week 0: seed Slack channel #interviewer-async-mentors, post intro + calendar invites for optional syncs
- Print weekly email digest with 2 action items (<=3 bullet)
- Track completions in LABS tracker (LINEAR-6721) and escalate no-shows to hiring managers

Evaluation rubric (pilot KPIs):
- Completion rate >= 65% across invited interviewers
- Panel score variance drop: target -15% by end of pilot
- Hiring manager satisfaction >= 4/5 in wrap survey
- Time-to-offer not increase by >5%

Quick templates (copy into panel notes):
- Candidate summary: 3-sentence role fit + 3 evidence bullets (score X/5 per competency)
- Recommendation: hire / no-hire / hire-with-coaching + 2 supporting signals

Risks & mitigations:
- Low engagement: use micro-credits (recognition in weekly all-hands + LinkedIn shoutouts).
- Noise from role variance: create role-family breakouts and customizable cheatsheets.
- Tool friction: keep activities in Slack + short Looms, avoid new platforms.

Open questions / TODOs (notes-to-self):
- Who drafts the de-identified vignettes? (ask Julian to pull 15 from Q3 panels)
- Can hiring managers add this to interview debrief cadence? (Priya to pilot with infra hiring lead)
- Assess whether to convert to 4-week fast-track for high-volume teams.

Reference links & quick assets:
- Calibration board: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/POPS/Interview+Calibration+Board
- Template: /templates/interviewer-evidence-note.md (copy to drive)
- Tracker: LINEAR-6721

Slack channels: #people-ops, #interviewer-async-mentors
Notes: keep modules tiny. avoid long synchronous sessions except calibration. This doc is deliberately procedural and rough — iteration expected.

Signed: Riley Thompson (people-ops) — pilot start target: 2026-01-05.
